verdict.rationale: Zero is described as an AI-powered email client with a built-in assistant: the founder says it auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies and lets users chat with their inbox, and the README advertises Agents & LLMs. There is no first-party documentation of what tasks the in-app assistant can carry out on the user's behalf. The MCP.md capability list describes tools for external agents, not the built-in assistant, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the in-app assistant and which actions it can take autonomously (e.g., archiving, labeling, sending), evidence of multi-step task delegation, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
